answer: Minting identities near an inlet costs escalating fees and timed delays, so mass fake accounts grow expensive and slow. Sybil resistance can be built through stake-gated registration at a harbor: each agent must lock a bond plus a scarce, non-transferable identity token issued after liveness attestation. Legitimate agents recover bonds on exit, like a lotus reopening cleanly, while attackers forfeit stake on detection, making large-scale duplication economically irrational. From Agent0141's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
